I had been using the older version of the period diary app for many years, and for the previous 12 months had written absolutely everything in it as we are trying to conceive. I updated the app in June without realising they had changed hands, and all of the data I had previously entered had disappeared. 
I then read the reviews and discovered other people in the same situation were encouraged to contact the support team, so I did that and was initially assisted by a friendly and helpful customer support advisor who reassured me that my data should be able to be recovered. I provided the information they asked for in order to search for my data and waited over two months with no response, so reached out to the support team again, and was dismissed by another customer support advisor who provided an unhelpful generic response advising that there is nothing they can do. 
I really need this information for my doctor to assist with my fertility journey, so am very disappointed. 
Hopefully this review might help other people before they update the app and lose their data too.

author: allnicknamestriedtakenhereyago
title: Please return this app to how it was before the update!!
review:
When I was younger, I never used to have the habit of tracking my periods regularly… I did not see the point because I thought my periods were inconsistent. A friend of mine eventually introduced me to this app a couple of years back saying it was amazing. I downloaded it and after using it for a few months, I came to really like it. This app allowed me to properly track my period for the first time in my life. And because of this app, I came to realize my periods were actually regular. This app used to be great - it had a simple layout, was easy to use, and was useful. Most importantly, it was accurate - it used to be able to tell me the exact day my period was going to come every month.  

However, the key word here is “used to be.” After the update, using this app is confusing. The layout is complicated. And for some reason it is now difficult to log the exact start and end dates of my period… sometimes it glitches and won’t let me click on the dates on the calendar, other times I have to click on the dates several times before it works. Worst of all, after the app updated, allll my logging dates of the last 3-4 years disappeared. On top of that, I’ve noticed that for the last 2 months the app hasn’t been telling me the date my period is going to arrive. 

 I’m pretty bummed out because of it. This app was great, and now, not so much. Downloading a different app is not that big of a deal, but the fact that I have to start from scratch with no data is actually quite frustrating. If there was any way to return this app to how it used to be, that would be amazing. More importantly, is there any way for my data to be returned to me???

author: Sazza21
title: What even is the update?
review:
Due to bad memory and many health issues, I’ve used this app daily for over a year and a half to keep track of my general health. This new update is so painful to deal with that if things don’t change soon, I’ll be looking to move my records to another app. The list below is by no means everything; just the key points.  

- The key used in the calendar is a mess to navigate. 
- There’s no dates on entries in charts. Sporadic access to scales means knowing the timeframe between entries can be important. Eg, did I lose a kilo in two days or in three weeks? Without dates and manually searching every entry, there’s no way to tell. 
- Zero options on appearance. We used to have three decent ones but now we’re forced to endure one annoying one. 
- Changed images for everything. Half of them, I can’t even tell the difference between them in the note let alone when using the calendar or charts. The other half just don’t make sense to begin with. 
- The logo. There is no “B” in “Period Diary” so it doesn’t relate to anything? If it’s a company thing, remember that apps have to make sense more than they need in-your-face branding. 

Also, it frequently glitches regarding the intimacy heart. I’ll press it and make sure it’s coloured in, then the next day it’ll be unselected. 

Please fix the design errors soon. I’ve been loyal to this app for a very long time so I’d hate to have to leave and find another due to this.

author: S_Ainslie
title: Absolutely gutted with the changes
review:
Gosh, I don’t think I have ever had to make a comment like this on anything!

I have used this app for an extremely long time, I’ll admit I am that old (now 38) that I can’t actually remember how long! I do know it has been at least 9 years but I am pretty sure it is a lot longer than that, maybe even 15 (if the app has been around that long!)

I am so very disappointed with the changes, my job is change management so believe me I am one of the biggest advocates for change .... in the right places and context! In my opinion these changes are pointless and regressive! The icons for expressions are stupid and meaningless. Don’t get me wrong, the flowers and hearts etc. seemed a little silly and girlie for me BUT it worked! It wasn’t sterile and emotionless which is what I feel I am now seeing! 

I am am a very serious and probably what most people would feel as harsh type of person but this is an area of my life where I am reminded I am a woman and forces the softer side! But as woman I feel I am more and more being pushed into a pot of combining with how everyone else in the world feels and thinks I should conform which to me means losing my identity as a woman! The softer girlie side .... that is not a weak or bad side of me (probably needed way more in every aspect of my life 😂) but a side worth celebrating. 

Anyway, back to my original point (teehee) I truly, truly loved this app for a very very long time but I don’t like what they have done with it. I truly mean no offence but it is like a bunch of people who don’t have periods have got together and decided this change would be good idea!!

Unless it changes in the next couple of months (I appreciate take overs can take time to bed in) then I will be looking for another app which I am already gutted about because I have my entire history stored in this thing 😢. 

So sorry if this has felt like a dig!!

Users options have been minimised, nay taken away completely, regarding the style/colour theme - we used to have three options, now there is no choice.  & what we are forced to use is ugly, hard on the eye & difficult to read through.
The symptom icons are also difficult to decipher; yes, you could say we were used to the previous ones but it’s not just that - take a good hard & honest look at them: some images, what even are they?!  and again with the colouring used it is difficult to see them, both in the calendar and graph screens.
Fair enough you’ve taken over this app but there was no need to make ALL these USELESS & annoying changes just to make a point of the takeover.
I will give it a month to see if you update according to all the feedback being provided by users, after which, if there hasn’t been sufficient improvement you’ve lost another loooooong time user.

Und das sind nur die Dinge die mir grad spontan einfallen...
Sitzt da auch jemand der die Dinge testet bevor die Programmierung online gestellt wird???

Wie gesagt theoretisch super aber praktisch in der Funktionalität ein Desaster.

author: Summer-ann
title: Great
review: I never write reviews but this little app deserves it. I've learnt so much through using it. I know how long my cycle is now and that it's not 28days and how long my period lasts which is not 7 days. Makes sense why I never knew when it was coming before the app because I was so wrong. I know my skin gets bad exactly a week before it comes so I take extra care of my skin at that point to stop it from going crazy like it used to. It took a bit of time to get used to how to update things and add notes properly also figuring out how to undo accidental taping of the flower in front(which starts logging your period) You click period log and then the minus beside the date you don't want btw. Period log also shows all your past cycles and the length of them as well as predictions. I noticed the predictions of mine were 28 day cycle which mine isn't but you just go into settings and change the length of the cycle to your own specific cycle length. Easy peasy. Never had any glitches with it, really like it. I keep getting my friends onto it.
